verdicts.reason: Both leave the 'Chase the light all summer' headline and a tiny, hard-to-read subline floating left-aligned above a large dead gap. The product box sits mid-canvas, and the bottom third is empty apart from a decorative circle. In A, the Solstice logo is minuscule and its sun icon has shrunk into an unreadable blob, and it is centred while the text is left-aligned. In B, the logo keeps its sun icon but is just as tiny and is dropped arbitrarily onto the pink circle at top right, sharing no edge with the left-aligned copy. B is marginally better only because the logo survives intact.
